# Brief U16.1-s4b-c172-linkages: c172-rc servos placed and linkages generated by `design add-linkage` (S3 Part B folded into S4 Part B, D120)

class: easy · role: builder · plan: §7 U16.1 S4 Part B (with S3 Part B, decision D120) · supersedes the Part B sections of `U16.1-s4-linkage-op.md`, `U16.1-s4-2-clearance.md` (pass check 4) and `U16.1-s3-servo-bays.md` · depends on: `std/u16.1-s4-linkage` merged to main (op `design add-linkage` with the S4-2 clearance construction and D119 overlay-off) · designs only: touches only `designs/c172-rc/`.

Branch `std/u16.1-s4b-showcase` from main after S4 merges; worktree `C:/Users/trist/wt/u16.1-linkage-b`. `PY=C:/ProgramData/miniforge3/python.exe`, `PLANE_CAD_OVERLAY=off`, `plane` = `$PY -m hangar.cli`. Run from the worktree root; paths are relative to it. Each command takes 5 to 60 s; run one at a time (never two commands on the same folder at once).

## Preconditions (check before step 1; any mismatch: stop)
1. `plane validate designs/c172-rc --tier all` has 0 FAIL rows (main baseline; T3.static_margin 13.0 % MAC, T5.part107_mass 616 g).
2. `plane design add-linkage --help` lists `--horn-toward` (renamed from `--horn-dir` in the S4 branch; if it still shows `--horn-dir`, use that name in step 5). Station semantics: `P = hinge location + station * axis`.
3. `designs/c172-rc/plane.yaml` has: components `servo-ail-r`, `servo-ail-l`, `servo-elev` at `position [590, 9, 2]`, `servo-rud` at `[590, -9, 2]`, none with `rotation_deg`; hinge attachments `wing-aileron-r` (location `[302, 410, 85]`), `wing-aileron-l` (`[302, -410, 85]`), `tail-elevator` (`[728, 60, 0]`, axis `[0, -1, 0]`), `tail-rudder` (`[699, 0, 60]`, axis `[0.127, 0, 1]`); the hand-made components `arm-`/`rod-`/`horn-`/`pin-` + `ail-r`, `ail-l`, `elev`, `rud`; the fuselage `cavities` list with the 5 elevator and rudder pockets and slits (kept as they are).

## Step 1: remove the hand-made linkages (one atomic call; ids exact)
```
plane design set designs/c172-rc "components[arm-ail-r]" --kind remove --why "S4b: replace hand-made linkages by add-linkage (D120)" \
  --also "components[rod-ail-r]=" --also "components[horn-ail-r]=" --also "components[pin-ail-r]=" \
  --also "components[arm-ail-l]=" --also "components[rod-ail-l]=" --also "components[horn-ail-l]=" --also "components[pin-ail-l]=" \
  --also "components[arm-elev]=" --also "components[rod-elev]=" --also "components[horn-elev]=" --also "components[pin-elev]=" \
  --also "components[arm-rud]=" --also "components[rod-rud]=" --also "components[horn-rud]=" --also "components[pin-rud]=" \
  --also "attachments[servo-arm-ail-r]=" --also "attachments[arm-rod-ail-r]=" --also "attachments[ail-horn-r]=" --also "attachments[horn-pin-ail-r]=" \
  --also "attachments[servo-arm-ail-l]=" --also "attachments[arm-rod-ail-l]=" --also "attachments[ail-horn-l]=" --also "attachments[horn-pin-ail-l]=" \
  --also "attachments[servo-arm-elev]=" --also "attachments[arm-rod-elev]=" --also "attachments[elev-horn]=" --also "attachments[horn-pin-elev]=" \
  --also "attachments[servo-arm-rud]=" --also "attachments[arm-rod-rud]=" --also "attachments[rud-horn]=" --also "attachments[horn-pin-rud]=" \
  --also "mechanisms[aileron-r-drive]=" --also "mechanisms[aileron-l-drive]=" --also "mechanisms[elevator-drive]=" --also "mechanisms[rudder-drive]="
```
Check: 16 components, 16 attachments and 4 mechanisms removed (the output lists each `-> None`).

## Step 2: servo placement (layout only; shafts toward the horn side; arm plane in the existing cavities)
```
plane design set designs/c172-rc "components[servo-ail-r].rotation_deg" --kind add --value "[0, 180, 0]" --why "S4b: shaft toward the horn side"
plane design set designs/c172-rc "components[servo-ail-l].rotation_deg" --kind add --value "[0, 180, 0]" --why "S4b: shaft toward the horn side"
plane design set designs/c172-rc "components[servo-elev].rotation_deg" --kind add --value "[0, 180, 0]" --why "S4b: shaft toward the horn side"
plane design set designs/c172-rc "components[servo-elev].position" --value "[590, 9, 2.55]" --why "S4b: arm plane z -10.8 (elevator pocket centre)"
plane design set designs/c172-rc "components[servo-rud].position" --value "[590, -9, 1.4]" --why "S4b: arm plane z 14.75 (rudder pocket centre)"
```
No `design place` and no new cavity: the servos sit inside the hollow fuselage (wall 3, S9c) and under the wing; the arm and rod planes coincide with the existing pockets and slits. Wing servos keep their positions.

## Step 3: generate the four linkages (each prints ratio, rod, tip, pin and the new FAIL rows; the FAIL list must be empty)
```
plane design add-linkage designs/c172-rc --servo servo-elev --hinge tail-elevator --station 45 --servo-range 10 --input-range 10 --why "S4b"
plane design add-linkage designs/c172-rc --servo servo-rud --hinge tail-rudder --station -43 --horn-toward 0,-1,0 --arm-side - --servo-range 10 --input-range 10 --why "S4b"
plane design add-linkage designs/c172-rc --servo servo-ail-r --hinge wing-aileron-r --station 0 --why "S4b"
plane design add-linkage designs/c172-rc --servo servo-ail-l --hinge wing-aileron-l --station 0 --why "S4b"
```
Expected first lines (abs 0.01 on numbers): elevator `ratio -0.56, rod 150.17 mm, tip [584.9189, 3.0146, -10.8], pin [734.7242, 13.5, -10.8]`; rudder `ratio 0.43, rod 105.29 mm, tip [595.5599, -14.9997, 14.75], pin [700.8484, -13.9481, 14.92]`; aileron-r `ratio 0.24, rod 58.28 mm, tip [270.5914, 414.0007, 60.65], pin [328.8693, 414.8885, 60.65]`; aileron-l `ratio 0.25, rod 58.28 mm, tip [271.6327, -425.8921, 60.65], pin [328.8693, -414.8885, 60.65]`. New component ids: `<hinge>-arm`, `-rod`, `-horn`, `-pin` (prefix = hinge id).

## Step 4: bill of materials follows the new ids
```
plane design set designs/c172-rc "bom.items[b-pushrods].component_ids" --value "[tail-elevator-rod, tail-rudder-rod, wing-aileron-r-rod, wing-aileron-l-rod]" --why "S4b: generated linkage ids"
plane design set designs/c172-rc "bom.items[b-arms-horns].component_ids" --value "[tail-elevator-arm, tail-elevator-horn, tail-rudder-arm, tail-rudder-horn, wing-aileron-r-arm, wing-aileron-r-horn, wing-aileron-l-arm, wing-aileron-l-horn]" --why "S4b: generated linkage ids"
plane design set designs/c172-rc "bom.items[b-pins].component_ids" --value "[tail-elevator-pin, tail-rudder-pin, wing-aileron-r-pin, wing-aileron-l-pin]" --why "S4b: generated linkage ids"
```

## Pass check
1. `plane validate designs/c172-rc --tier all`: 0 FAIL rows (all tiers). `T0`, `T1.interference` PASS ("no clipping between unattached parts"). T6 `mechanism`, `link` and `ratio` PASS for `tail-elevator-drive`, `tail-rudder-drive`, `wing-aileron-r-drive`, `wing-aileron-l-drive`. Minimum transmission angles about 52.8, 58.5, 40.3, 42.8 degrees. WARN count 26 as on main.
2. Reference scratch result (measured 2026-11-26 on main 1bcb7a9, overlay off): 0 FAIL; mass 616 g -> 627 g; CG x 253 -> 256 mm; static margin 13.0 -> 10.4 % MAC (band 5-25 %). Report the new values; a different number means a different base: stop.
3. Second pass of the four `add-linkage` calls leaves `plane.yaml` bytes unchanged (`cmp` against a copy).
4. `plane baseline update designs/c172-rc`, `plane baseline check --all` exit 0, `plane progress --write` only if the conductor ticks boxes (not you).
5. `git diff --name-only main...HEAD | grep -v "^designs/c172-rc/"` prints nothing (no `core/`).

## Commit
`design(c172-rc): servos placed, generated linkages via add-linkage (U16.1 S3+S4 Part B, D120)`, blank line, `Base: main`, blank line, trailers. Push `std/u16.1-s4b-showcase`; PR; report CI `headSha`. Studio check: all four surfaces play pinned linkages.

## Stop rule
Stop and report (paste rows, do not change thresholds, constants or code) if: a precondition value differs; a command errors; any FAIL row appears, in an `add-linkage` output or in the validate; a printed pin or tip differs by more than 0.01 mm; the second pass changes bytes; or a fix needs a cavity or a core change. A FAIL is a finding for the conductor; the layout levers are servo position (`design set`), `--station`, `--arm-side`, `--horn-toward`, never a threshold.
